fieldValues.title: A Protocol cannot declare nine things the minutes process needs
fieldValues.summary: The generic runner had to supply nine conventions outside the package: an anchored type, checkable completion, which end a required relation binds, which stage writes which link, create versus update, a stage's inputs, a place for "not established", a record of the process, and room for tool hints.
evidence: srs-lab minutes/runner.mjs HINTS and derived rules
srs-lab minutes/README.md, What SRS is missing
fieldValues.body: Each is a place where two tools given the same package could run the process differently. Definition schemas are closed, so a package cannot carry them as extension data.
